_meta.file_purpose: WHAT THE DETECTOR LOOKS FOR (Stage 2 of the POC pipeline). Each key is a plain English phrase handed to Grounding DINO; each value lists the cube_table size classes that phrase could turn out to be.
_meta.why_it_matters: Two jobs. (1) Anything not listed here is invisible to BOTH methods - it is the first thing to check when stage 9 reports items 'missed entirely'. (2) The value list narrows Method B's candidates when matching a measurement to a size class, which is worth ~18 percentage points of accuracy at realistic error levels. Never match a measurement against the whole table.
_meta.how_to_edit: Add a phrase as a new key with the plausible size classes as its value. Keep phrases lowercase - Grounding DINO expects that. An empty list means 'detect but do not treat as cargo'.
_meta.special_case: 'door' has an empty class list on purpose. It is detected only to act as the 1981mm measuring stick in Stage 4, and is excluded from the inventory.
_meta.used_by: stage 2 (prompts) and stage 5 (which size classes a label permits)
